verdict.rationale: Gladia documents an async pre-recorded API whose quickstart takes a local file or remote URL and "let[s] the method handle the rest". Its official CLI reduces the whole flow to setting a key and running `gladia transcribe audio.mp3`, with machine-readable JSON output to stdout. The docs are also agent-readable via llms.txt and .md endpoints, so an agent with a key can plausibly reach a finished transcript unattended. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the raw REST auth header and the job-creation and result-polling endpoints, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully unattended run.
